title: Welcome To Github
excerpts:
"body": "This release establishes the October 30, 2026 evidence snapshot for welcome-to-github.

Following the October 14 Fourteen-Day Evidence Checkpoint, it captures the repository's accumulated October 1–30 Horizon H1/H2 research, H6 month-to-date reconciliation, weekly H3/H4 relationships, and independent Parallax research
records.

The snapshot preserves original source states, producer-time boundaries, provenance continuity, historical corrections, and the distinction between native research observations and derived maintenance relationships.
The October 30 reconciliation consolidates the retained daily evidence without rewriting original records or promoting unresolved observations into verified results.

W43 retains its recorded blocked and NO_DECISION boundaries, while W44 and the natural-month final remain open or not yet due.
Repository evidence does not establish independent host remediation, external execution success, or complete runtime verification.\

title: Citation File Format (CFF)
excerpts:
# What is a `CITATION.cff` file?
`CITATION.cff` files are plain text files with human- and machine-readable citation information for software (and datasets).
Code developers can include them in their repositories to let others know how to correctly cite their software.

...

```
cff-version : 1.2.0 message : " If you use this software, please cite it as below." authors : - family-names : Druskat given-names : Stephan orcid : https://orcid.org/1234-5678-9101-1121 title : " My Research Software" version : 2.0.4 identifiers : - type : doi value : 10.5281/zenodo.1234 date-released : 2021-08-11
```
The format of `CITATION.cff` files is the **Citation File Format (CFF)** .

...
